# developer.paypal.com documentation — Api — Subscriptions

> 18 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Api under Subscriptions. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Subscriptions

- [v1](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1): Copy for LLMView as MarkdownAPI Reference OverviewSubscriptions v1plans7 endpointsGETList plans/v1/billing/plansLists billing plans.POSTCreate plan/v1/billing/plansCreates a plan…
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/plans-create): Creates a plan that defines pricing and billing cycle details for subscriptions.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/subscriptions-create): Creates a subscription.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/plans-patch/): Updates a plan with the `CREATED` or `ACTIVE` status. For an `INACTIVE` plan, you can make only status updates.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/plans-activate/): Activates a plan, by ID.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/plans-update-pricing-schemes/): Updates pricing for a plan. For example, you can update a regular billing cycle from $5 per month to $7 per month.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/plans-deactivate/): Deactivates a plan, by ID.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/subscriptions-activate/): Activates the subscription.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/subscriptions-patch/): Updates a subscription which could be in
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/subscriptions-get/): Shows details for a subscription, by ID.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/subscriptions-cancel/): Cancels the subscription.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/subscriptions-suspend/): Suspends the subscription.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/plans-list): Lists billing plans.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/plans-get): Shows details for a plan, by ID.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/subscriptions-list): List all subscriptions for merchant account.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/subscriptions-revise): Updates the quantity of the product or service in a subscription.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/subscriptions-capture): Captures an authorized payment from the subscriber on the subscription.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1/subscriptions-transactions): Lists transactions for a subscription.
